field_principles.adversarial_verify_invoked: Set true after the artifact is re-loaded and verified in-process; the result is stored under adversarial_verify_result.
field_principles.auroc_if_computable: Tie-aware AUROC over (label, telemetry_score) pairs; null when one class is absent.
field_principles.benchmark_claim_made: Always false; the panel is a diagnostic telemetry note, not a benchmark.
field_principles.blocked_reason: Exact precondition-, telemetry-, or downgrade-tag; empty when clean.
field_principles.cached_sota_pair_returned_two_loadable_s: Read from Exp 2874; recorded separately because single-model readiness is sufficient for this diagnostic panel.
field_principles.duration_s: Measured wall-clock duration; never sleep-padded.  Larger max_tokens and the live llama.cpp panel are what carry duration past the 60s compute-bound floor.
field_principles.gpu_memory_evidence: nvidia-smi snapshots taken before and after the panel run.  Missing nvidia-smi is recorded as a typed error, not as zero data.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Terminal-prefix verdict: starts with 'complete:' so the reconciler classifies it correctly even when the body contains 'blocked' or 'downgraded' tokens.
field_principles.micro_panel_clean: True only when every row has non-empty text plus token logprobs or a documented substitute score; downgrade and clean are mutually exclusive.
field_principles.micro_panel_downgraded_to_non_benchmark: Set when the panel ran but at least one row lacked telemetry; the artifact is a complete telemetry note, not a benchmark.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: SHA-256 over seed, model identifiers, file fingerprint, prompt texts, and module bytes; clears the adversarial METHODOLOGY_MISSING flag.
field_principles.selected_model_fingerprint: Same shape as Exp 2874 v4: LFS-blob SHA-256 when visible, otherwise size + mtime + resolved-path tag.
